info.name: TimeForCode local (all APIs)
info.description: Every endpoint of the Authorization, Donation and Reporting APIs, converted from their OpenAPI documents by scripts/generate-postman-collection.ps1. Fill the collection variables, run the Setup request for an admin token, then the rest. Requests inherit bearer authentication with `{{token}}`; anonymous endpoints ignore it.

request.description: Not part of the OpenAPI documents: the endpoint is hidden and only answers when the stack was started with TEST_ADMIN_ACCESS_SECRET (ADR-017). Stores the admin access token in the collection variable `token`.

An organization is measured on the hours logged on its Active and Completed donations and earns the badges of the
tiers with recipient type `Organization`.

A contributor is measured on the total hours they logged themselves and earns the badges of the tiers with recipient
type `Contributor`. Only badge names and award dates are exposed, no other personal data.
Only the tiers of this recipient type; all tiers when omitted. (This can only be one of Organization,Contributor)

Badges already awarded stay when a threshold is raised. A tier added or lowered is awarded to recipients who already
qualify the next time their badges are requested.
(Required) Who the tier is for: `Organization` or `Contributor`. (This can only be one of Organization,Contributor)
(Required) The tier name, 1 to 100 characters, unique per recipient type.

Only Active and Completed donations count as received; Pending and Cancelled ones are listed and counted per status.
Only published projects can be reported on; an unpublished project answers 404, also for its maintainer.
Only Active and Completed donations count: a Pending donation is not yet committed and a Cancelled one no longer is.

CSV columns: ContributionId, ProjectId, ContributorLogin, Hours, GithubReference, LoggedAt (UTC, ISO 8601). JSON has the same
values as camel case fields in a `contributions` list. Contributions are attributed by the contributor's current
affiliation, so a contributor who moves to another organization takes their history along. Deleted contributions are left out.
The file format, `Json` (default) or `Csv`. (This can only be one of Json,Csv)
